fr_html: Mais si les parties sont ainsi tenues de soumettre leurs litiges à l'arbitrage, il convient de se demander quelle Cour d'arbitrage sera compétente. La réponse, c'est que la compétence appartient à la cour à laquelle les parties auront convenu de s'adresser; il n'est donc pas question de la Cour Permanente de Justice.
en_html: But if the parties were thus bound to submit their disputes to Arbitration, the question arises what Court of Arbitration is competent. The answer is that the court to which the parties have agreed to appeal shall be competent. There is no question, therefore, of the Permanent Court of Justice.
